Description: Annual end-use gas demand from industry
Definition: Gas used in industry, including for electricity generation from gas distribution network connected Combined Heat and Power plants (CHPs) and Combined Cycle Gas Turbines (CCGTs), and industrial gas usage fitted with CCS

Description: Annual end-use gas demand from the commercial sector
Definition: Gas used in the commercial sector, excluding gas used for electricity generation by peaking/flexible plants
Gas used in the transport sector, including networked Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) and non-networked Liquified Natural Gas (LNG)
Gas used in the residential sector, including for heating and cooking (using NDM1 gas load band)

Description: Total gas demand (gas NTS connected only) for electricity generation
Definition: Gas used for power generation, for power stations connected to the gas transmission network
Gas used for electricity generation by flexible/peaking plants connected to the gas distribution networks
Total gas shrinkage from transmission and distribution networks
Gas used for producing hydrogen via steam methane reforming
Gas export through to Ireland and Continental Europe
Total daily GB gas demand on a cold day expected to occur once every 20 years. Data is in gas years, i.e. 2022 is GY 2022/23 which is 01/10/2022 - 30/09/2023
